paragraphs.text:
As you enter the building, a young
woman stands before you. She is
translucent, her hair buffeted by
an eerie wind that you cannot feel.
The woman speaks. Her voice
sends shivers down your spine.
She has a visible wound on neck.
“He killed me with that axe and i
cannot rest until the same
happens to him.”  She points at a
large blood spattered axe in a dark
corner of the room.
You may pick up the axe. The axe
will give you a +1 to attacks against
the Polka-Dot-Dress Maniac if you
meet him.
